WITH movimentos AS (
    SELECT
        f.cod_filial,
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', f.competencia_data)
             AS DATE) AS competencia,
        d.ordem_dre,
        SUM(f.valor * c.tipolancamento) AS valor
    FROM workspace.gold.fato_lancamentos f
    JOIN workspace.gold.dim_conta c
        ON f.planocontas_id = c.id_conta
    JOIN workspace.gold.dim_dre d
        ON c.mascaradre_id = d.id_dre
    WHERE d.subtotal = 0
    GROUP BY
        f.cod_filial,
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', f.competencia_data)
             AS DATE),
        d.ordem_dre
),
resumo AS (
    SELECT
        cod_filial,
        competencia,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 1 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 2 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 4 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l4,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 6 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l6,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 7 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l7,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 9 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l9,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 10 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l10,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 12 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l12
    FROM movimentos
    GROUP BY cod_filial, competencia
),
dre_calculada AS (
    SELECT
        r.cod_filial,
        r.competencia,
        d.ordem_dre,
        d.descricao_dre,
        d.subtotal,
        CASE d.ordem_dre
            WHEN 1 THEN r.l1
            WHEN 2 THEN r.l2
            WHEN 3 THEN r.l1 + r.l2
            WHEN 4 THEN r.l4
            WHEN 5 THEN r.l1 + r.l2 + r.l4
            WHEN 6 THEN r.l6
            WHEN 7 THEN r.l7
            WHEN 8 THEN NULL
            WHEN 9 THEN r.l9
            WHEN 10 THEN r.l10
            WHEN 11 THEN NULL
            WHEN 12 THEN r.l12
            WHEN 13 THEN
                r.l1 + r.l2 + r.l4 + r.l6
                + r.l7 + r.l9 + r.l10 + r.l12
        END AS valor_dre
    FROM resumo r
    JOIN workspace.gold.dim_dre d
        ON r.cod_filial = d.cod_filial
)
SELECT
    f.filial,
    d.competencia,
    YEAR(d.competencia) AS ano,
    d.ordem_dre,
    d.descricao_dre,
    d.subtotal,
    ROUND(d.valor_dre, 2) AS valor_dre
FROM dre_calculada d
JOIN workspace.gold.dim_filial f
    ON d.cod_filial = f.cod_filial

WITH cenarios AS (
    SELECT
        'Realizado' AS cenario,
        cod_filial,
        competencia_data,
        planocontas_id,
        valor
    FROM workspace.gold.fato_lancamentos

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Orçamento',
        cod_filial,
        competencia_data,
        planocontas_id,
        valor
    FROM workspace.gold.fato_orcamento

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Previsão',
        cod_filial,
        competencia_data,
        planocontas_id,
        valor
    FROM workspace.gold.fato_previsao
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        f.cenario,
        f.cod_filial,
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', f.competencia_data)
             AS DATE) AS competencia,
        f.planocontas_id,
        c.mascaradre_id,
        f.valor * c.tipolancamento AS valor_ajustado
    FROM cenarios f
    JOIN workspace.gold.dim_conta c
        ON f.planocontas_id = c.id_conta
),
resumo AS (
    SELECT
        cod_filial,
        competencia,
        planocontas_id,
        mascaradre_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cenario = 'Realizado'
                 THEN valor_ajustado END) AS realizado,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cenario = 'Orçamento'
                 THEN valor_ajustado END) AS orcado,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cenario = 'Previsão'
                 THEN valor_ajustado END) AS previsto
    FROM base
    GROUP BY
        cod_filial,
        competencia,
        planocontas_id,
        mascaradre_id
)
SELECT
    r.*,
    CASE
        WHEN r.realizado IS NOT NULL AND r.orcado IS NOT NULL
        THEN r.realizado - r.orcado
    END AS desvio_orcamento,
    CASE
        WHEN r.realizado IS NOT NULL
         AND r.orcado IS NOT NULL
         AND r.orcado <> 0
        THEN (r.realizado - r.orcado) / ABS(r.orcado)
    END AS desvio_orcamento_pct
FROM resumo r

WITH fontes AS (
    SELECT
        'Realizado' AS cenario,
        cod_filial,
        competencia_data,
        planocontas_id,
        valor
    FROM workspace.gold.fato_lancamentos

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Orcamento',
        cod_filial,
        competencia_data,
        planocontas_id,
        valor
    FROM workspace.gold.fato_orcamento

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Previsao',
        cod_filial,
        competencia_data,
        planocontas_id,
        valor
    FROM workspace.gold.fato_previsao
),
movimentos AS (
    SELECT
        f.cenario,
        f.cod_filial,
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', f.competencia_data) AS DATE)
            AS competencia,
        d.ordem_dre,
        f.valor * c.tipolancamento AS valor_ajustado
    FROM fontes f
    JOIN workspace.gold.dim_conta c
        ON f.planocontas_id = c.id_conta
    JOIN workspace.gold.dim_dre d
        ON c.mascaradre_id = d.id_dre
    WHERE d.subtotal = 0
),
grupos AS (
    SELECT
        cenario,
        cod_filial,
        competencia,
        ordem_dre,
        SUM(valor_ajustado) AS valor
    FROM movimentos
    GROUP BY cenario, cod_filial, competencia, ordem_dre
),
resumo AS (
    SELECT
        cenario,
        cod_filial,
        competencia,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 1 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 2 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 4 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l4,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 6 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l6,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 7 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l7,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 9 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l9,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 10 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l10,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordem_dre = 12 THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS l12
    FROM grupos
    GROUP BY cenario, cod_filial, competencia
),
calculo AS (
    SELECT
        r.cenario,
        r.cod_filial,
        r.competencia,
        d.ordem_dre,
        d.descricao_dre,
        d.subtotal,
        CASE d.ordem_dre
            WHEN 1 THEN r.l1
            WHEN 2 THEN r.l2
            WHEN 3 THEN r.l1 + r.l2
            WHEN 4 THEN r.l4
            WHEN 5 THEN r.l1 + r.l2 + r.l4
            WHEN 6 THEN r.l6
            WHEN 7 THEN r.l7
            WHEN 8 THEN NULL
            WHEN 9 THEN r.l9
            WHEN 10 THEN r.l10
            WHEN 11 THEN NULL
            WHEN 12 THEN r.l12
            WHEN 13 THEN r.l1 + r.l2 + r.l4 + r.l6
                         + r.l7 + r.l9 + r.l10 + r.l12
        END AS valor_dre
    FROM resumo r
    JOIN workspace.gold.dim_dre d
        ON r.cod_filial = d.cod_filial
)
SELECT
    d.cod_filial,
    f.filial,
    d.competencia,
    YEAR(d.competencia) AS ano,
    d.ordem_dre,
    d.descricao_dre,
    d.subtotal,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cenario = 'Realizado'
             THEN valor_dre END) AS realizado,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cenario = 'Orcamento'
             THEN valor_dre END) AS orcado,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cenario = 'Previsao'
             THEN valor_dre END) AS previsto
FROM calculo d
JOIN workspace.gold.dim_filial f
    ON d.cod_filial = f.cod_filial
GROUP BY
    d.cod_filial,
    f.filial,
    d.competencia,
    YEAR(d.competencia),
    d.ordem_dre,
    d.descricao_dre,
    d.subtotal
